title: Barefoot Daze | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Located 100 Yards From the Gulf with private beach access- Barefoot Daze By Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Barefoot Daze by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 75 Geoff Wilder Lane Details: Barefoot Daze is located in Water’s Edge, an upscale gated gulf-front community bordering Rosemary Beach on the gulf side of Scenic Highway 30A. With 5 bedrooms encompassing 3 levels, a private pool, and 1,100 square feet of balconies offering gulf views and breezes, this is the perfect vacation home for guests seeking an upscale beach retreat. This charming Florida home has many custom finishes including high ceilings, pine floors, and wainscoting. This home’s private pool can be heated for a fee, allowing enjoyment in any season. The covered rear porch area has a gas grill and outdoor table seating for 8. Just past the pool area, a palm tree-lined pedestrian path leads to the neighborhood’s private beach walkover just100 yards away. With only 26 home-sites and a security gate, Water’s Edge has almost no car traffic. By foot or by bike, the town centers of Seacrest Beach, Alys Beach, and Rosemary Beach are just a few minutes away. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 400 Feet (2 Minute Walk) -Parking Spaces: 2 in Driveway -Gated Community -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8, Bar Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available -Propane Grill Available (Propane Provided) -*Private Heated Pool 10’ x 20’ *Pool heat is available for an additional $280 (pre-tax) *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps 12 5 Bedrooms / 4.5 Bathrooms First Floor: -Bedroom 1: Queen Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Kitchen / Living Area / Dining Area -Half Bath Second Floor: -Bedroom 2 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Shared Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 4: Twin/Twin Bunks with Shared Bath (Shower) -Laundry Room Third Floor: -Bedroom 5: Two Queen Beds with Private Bath (Shower) -Wet Bar Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes -Beach Towel Service -1 Beach Service Set* *Seasonal: March – November Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
